EN-SPK-F00-Q01.text: Let's start nice and easy. Listen to the word, then say it back.

EN-SPK-F00-Q02.text: What is in this picture? Say it out loud.

EN-SPK-F00-Q03.text: There's one word on the card. Read it out loud whenever you're ready.

EN-SPK-F00-Q04.text: Listen to this short question, then answer it out loud.

EN-SPK-F00-Q05.text: Listen carefully. Then say exactly what you heard.

EN-SPK-F00-Q06.text: Read the word on the card out loud. Take your time.

EN-SPK-F00-Q07.text: What do you see in this picture? Tell me its name out loud.

EN-SPK-F00-Q08.text: Listen to the question. You'll hear two choices. Say the one that answers it.

EN-SPK-T01-Q01.text: Here's a word to warm up your voice. Listen closely, then say it back just the way you heard it.

EN-SPK-T01-Q02.text: Get ready to listen. One word is coming. When it finishes, repeat it in your clearest voice.

EN-SPK-T01-Q03.text: Quick echo challenge: listen to the word, then copy it exactly, sound for sound.

EN-SPK-T01-Q04.text: Take a breath and listen. When the word ends, say it back as clearly as you can.

EN-SPK-T01-Q05.text: Listen to this word all the way to the end, then say the whole thing back with every sound included.

EN-SPK-T01-Q06.text: Your turn to be the echo. Listen to the word, then say it back exactly as you heard it.

EN-SPK-T01-Q07.text: Listen carefully to what you hear, then say it back, matching every sound as closely as you can.

EN-SPK-T01-Q08.text: Ears ready? Listen to the word, then repeat it slowly and clearly. There's no hurry.

EN-SPK-T01-Q09.text: Ready for a funny-sounding word? Listen closely, then say it back to me just like you heard it.

EN-SPK-T01-Q10.text: Let's play echo. Listen to the word, then say it right back to me, nice and clear.

EN-SPK-T02-Q01.text: Look at the letter on the card. Don't say its name. Say the sound it makes when you read it in a word.

EN-SPK-T02-Q02.text: Here's a letter to sound out. What sound does it make? Say just the sound, not the letter's name.

EN-SPK-T02-Q03.text: Take a look at this letter. Think about the sound it makes at the start of a word, then say that sound.

EN-SPK-T02-Q04.text: Detective time. Look at the letter on the screen and say the sound it makes. Keep it short and crisp.

EN-SPK-T02-Q05.text: These two letters work as a team to make one sound. Look at them, then say the sound they make together.

EN-SPK-T02-Q06.text: Two letters, one sound. Look at the pair on the card and say the sound they make together.

EN-SPK-T02-Q07.text: Look closely at these two letters. Say the sound they make when they team up in a word.

EN-SPK-T02-Q08.text: Here are two letters side by side. What sound do they make together? Say it out loud.

EN-SPK-T02-Q09.text: Two letters on the card like to stick together. Can you say the sound they make as a pair?

EN-SPK-T02-Q10.text: Three letters are hiding one sound. Look at them on the card, then say the sound they make together.

EN-SPK-T03-Q01.text: What's this picture showing? Have a look, then say its name out loud.

EN-SPK-T03-Q02.text: Say the word for what's in this picture, nice and clearly.

EN-SPK-T03-Q03.text: Take a good look at this picture. What is it? Tell me in one word.

EN-SPK-T03-Q04.text: You might spot this at home. Name the thing in the picture out loud.

EN-SPK-T03-Q05.text: Study the picture for a moment, then say what it is.

EN-SPK-T03-Q06.text: Look closely at the picture and say what this object is called.

EN-SPK-T03-Q07.text: This picture shows a sign. Look carefully and say what it shows.

EN-SPK-T03-Q08.text: Name what you see in this picture. One word is plenty.

EN-SPK-T03-Q09.text: Who's come to visit today? Look at the picture and tell me who it is.

EN-SPK-T03-Q10.text: Peek at the picture. Who is this little visitor? Say its name out loud.

EN-SPK-T04-Q01.text: Three short words are waiting on the card. Read them out loud, one at a time, nice and clearly.

EN-SPK-T04-Q02.text: Your turn to read. Say each word on the card out loud, in order from left to right.

EN-SPK-T04-Q03.text: Take your time with these three words. Read each one out loud and give every sound a chance.

EN-SPK-T04-Q04.text: Here are three useful words. Read them out loud one by one. There's no rush.

EN-SPK-T04-Q05.text: These words have a few tricky letter groups. Read them slowly and out loud, one at a time.

EN-SPK-T04-Q06.text: Ready for a reading challenge? Say the three words on the card out loud, in order.

EN-SPK-T04-Q07.text: Read the three words on the card out loud. Give each one your full attention before moving to the next.

EN-SPK-T04-Q08.text: Find a relaxed, steady pace for these. Read the three words on the card out loud, one after the other.

EN-SPK-T04-Q09.text: Ready to read some fun words? Say each word on the card out loud, one at a time.

EN-SPK-T04-Q10.text: These three words are great fun to say. Read them out loud, one by one, as clearly as you can.

EN-SPK-T05-Q01.text: There's a short sentence on the card. Read it out loud from start to finish, at your own pace.

EN-SPK-T05-Q02.text: Read the sentence on the card out loud. Try to keep going smoothly all the way to the full stop.

EN-SPK-T05-Q03.text: One sentence, one word at a time. Read each word, then say the whole sentence out loud.

EN-SPK-T05-Q04.text: Start with your eyes on the first word, then read the sentence out loud all the way to the end.

EN-SPK-T05-Q05.text: This sentence is a bit longer. Take a breath, then read it out loud from beginning to end.

EN-SPK-T05-Q06.text: Your turn to read. Say the sentence on the card out loud, clearly enough for someone across the room to hear.

EN-SPK-T05-Q07.text: Read this sentence out loud. If a word slows you down, sound it out and keep going.

EN-SPK-T05-Q08.text: When you're ready, read the sentence on the card out loud in your normal speaking voice.

EN-SPK-T05-Q09.text: This sentence tells a funny little story. Read it out loud, and take your time with the longer words.

EN-SPK-T05-Q10.text: Ready for a fun sentence? Read it out loud, word by word, and see what picture it makes in your head.

EN-SPK-T06-Q01.text: Can you think of a word that rhymes with the one on the card? Say it out loud.

EN-SPK-T06-Q02.text: Rhyming time. Read the word on the screen, then say a different word that ends with the same sound.

EN-SPK-T06-Q03.text: Words that rhyme sound the same at the end. Read the word on the card and say one that rhymes with it.

EN-SPK-T06-Q04.text: Find a word that rhymes with the one on the card, and say it out loud. Any real rhyming word will do.

EN-SPK-T06-Q05.text: Read the word on the card. Now hunt for a word that rhymes with it, and say it out loud.

EN-SPK-T06-Q06.text: Read this word, then try to say another word that ends with the same sound.

EN-SPK-T06-Q07.text: Check the word on the card, then think of a word that rhymes with it. Say it out loud when you've got one.

EN-SPK-T06-Q08.text: Your rhyming challenge: read the word on the screen and say a word that rhymes with it.

EN-SPK-T06-Q09.text: Read the bouncy word on the card. Can you think of a word that rhymes with it? Say it out loud.

EN-SPK-T06-Q10.text: Let's find a rhyming buddy for the word on the card. What word sounds the same at the end?

EN-SPK-T07-Q01.text: Clap it out: read the word on the card and say it in parts, one clap for each part you hear.

EN-SPK-T07-Q02.text: Let's break a word into beats. Say water slowly in parts, and clap for each one.

EN-SPK-T07-Q03.text: Read the word on the screen, then say it in parts with a clap for every beat. How many claps does it need?

EN-SPK-T07-Q04.text: Toothbrush is the word this time. Say it slowly, clapping once for each part.

EN-SPK-T07-Q05.text: Get your hands ready. Say banana in its parts, and give each part its own clap.

EN-SPK-T07-Q06.text: Think about the word umbrella. Break it into parts as you say it, and clap for every part.

EN-SPK-T07-Q07.text: Say the word kindness slowly, one part at a time, and clap as you say each part.

EN-SPK-T07-Q08.text: Your challenge: split recycle into its beats. Clap once for each part as you say it.

EN-SPK-T07-Q09.text: Caterpillar is a long, wriggly word. Can you say it in parts and clap for every bit?

EN-SPK-T07-Q10.text: Hippopotamus is a really big word. Say it in parts and clap for each one. How many claps do you get?

EN-SPK-T08-Q01.text: Listen to the sentence. Where you hear a beep, a word is missing. Say the word that fits.

EN-SPK-T08-Q02.text: A word in this sentence has been swapped for a beep. Listen to the whole thing, then say the word that belongs there.

EN-SPK-T08-Q03.text: Listen carefully. One word is hiding behind a beep. Which word would make the sentence make sense? Say it out loud.

EN-SPK-T08-Q04.text: This sentence has a gap in it. Listen, then fill the gap by saying the missing word.

EN-SPK-T08-Q05.text: Notice where the beep comes in this sentence. Listen, then say what belongs in that spot.

EN-SPK-T08-Q06.text: Something's missing from this sentence. Listen all the way through, then say the word that fills the beep.

EN-SPK-T08-Q07.text: Listen to this everyday sentence. When the beep comes, think about what fits, then say that word.

EN-SPK-T08-Q08.text: One word is missing from this sentence. Listen, then say the word that would complete it. Take your time to think.

EN-SPK-T08-Q09.text: Uh oh, a beep has gobbled up a word. Listen to the sentence and say a word that could go there.

EN-SPK-T08-Q10.text: Oh no, a word has gone missing behind a beep in this funny sentence. Listen, then say a word that fits.

EN-SPK-T09-Q01.text: Think about the word hot. What word means the opposite? Say it out loud.

EN-SPK-T09-Q02.text: Big is the word. Now flip it around. What's its opposite? Say it out loud.

EN-SPK-T09-Q03.text: Turn this word around in meaning: fast. What's the opposite? Say it out loud.

EN-SPK-T09-Q04.text: Start with the word up. What word means the very opposite? Say it clearly.

EN-SPK-T09-Q05.text: Think about the word kind, as in a kind person. What's the opposite? Say it out loud.

EN-SPK-T09-Q06.text: The word is safe. What word means the opposite of safe? Say it out loud.

EN-SPK-T09-Q07.text: Save, as in saving money. What word means the opposite? Say it out loud.

EN-SPK-T09-Q08.text: Picture an empty cup. What word means the opposite of empty? Say it out loud.

EN-SPK-T09-Q09.text: Shh, the word is quiet. What's the opposite of quiet? Tell me in your speaking voice.

EN-SPK-T09-Q10.text: Imagine a brave knight. What word means the opposite of brave? Say it out loud.

EN-SPK-T10-Q01.text: Look at the word cat on the card. Say each letter out loud, one at a time, in order.

EN-SPK-T10-Q02.text: Spell the word dog out loud. Say its letters one by one, from first to last.

EN-SPK-T10-Q03.text: Bag is the word on the card. Can you say every letter in it, in the right order?

EN-SPK-T10-Q04.text: Your turn to spell out loud. Name each letter in the word sun, one after another.

EN-SPK-T10-Q05.text: Spell help out loud, reading its letters from left to right.

EN-SPK-T10-Q06.text: Spell wait out loud, letter by letter. Take your time and keep them in order.

EN-SPK-T10-Q07.text: Spell the word share out loud, naming each letter in turn.

EN-SPK-T10-Q08.text: Friend can be a tricky word to spell. Look at it carefully, then say each letter out loud in order.

EN-SPK-T10-Q09.text: Let's spell giggle. Look at the word and say each letter out loud, one by one.

EN-SPK-T10-Q10.text: Butterfly is a long word. Can you say all of its letters out loud, from the very first to the very last?

EN-SPK-T11-Q01.text: Look at the picture and tell me what's happening. One or two sentences is perfect.

EN-SPK-T11-Q02.text: Have a look at this picture. What do you notice? Describe it in a sentence or two.

EN-SPK-T11-Q03.text: Take a moment with the picture. Describe what's going on, using one or two full sentences.

EN-SPK-T11-Q04.text: Imagine you're telling someone about this picture. What's happening? Say it in one or two sentences.

EN-SPK-T11-Q05.text: Study the picture like a detective. What's happening in it? Describe it in one or two sentences.

EN-SPK-T11-Q06.text: Two things appear in this picture. How do they go together? Tell me what you see in a sentence or two.

EN-SPK-T11-Q07.text: Scan the picture from left to right. What is happening? Describe it in one or two sentences.

EN-SPK-T11-Q08.text: What story do the symbols in this picture tell? Describe it in one or two sentences.

EN-SPK-T11-Q09.text: Ooh, something funny is going on in this picture. Can you tell me what's happening in one or two sentences?

EN-SPK-T11-Q10.text: Who's in this picture, and what do you think happened? Tell me in a sentence or two.

EN-SPK-T12-Q01.text: How many animals can you name before the time runs out? Say them out loud, one after another.

EN-SPK-T12-Q02.text: Think of all the foods you know. Name as many as you can before time's up.

EN-SPK-T12-Q03.text: Let's see how many colours you can name. Keep going until the time runs out.

EN-SPK-T12-Q04.text: Think about things that keep you safe. Name as many as you can before time is up.

EN-SPK-T12-Q05.text: What kind things can you do? Name as many as you can think of before time's up.

EN-SPK-T12-Q06.text: Think of different ways to save money. Say as many as you can before the time runs out.

EN-SPK-T12-Q07.text: What needs water? Name as many things as you can before time's up, big or small.

EN-SPK-T12-Q08.text: Time to be noisy. What silly sounds do animals make? Say as many as you can before the time runs out.

EN-SPK-T12-Q09.text: Which words are fun to say out loud? Say as many as you can think of before the time is up.

EN-SPK-T12-Q10.text: Imagine a party table. What foods might be on it? Name as many as you can before time's up.

EN-SPK-T13-Q01.text: There's no rush. Listen to the question, then answer it out loud in your own words.

EN-SPK-T13-Q02.text: A question is coming your way. Listen carefully, then say your answer out loud.

EN-SPK-T13-Q03.text: Listen all the way to the end of the question, then give me your answer out loud.

EN-SPK-T13-Q04.text: Get ready to listen. When the question finishes, say your answer out loud.

EN-SPK-T13-Q05.text: Picture yourself in the situation you're about to hear. Listen, then say what you would do, out loud.

EN-SPK-T13-Q06.text: Once the question finishes, take a moment to think it through, then answer out loud.

EN-SPK-T13-Q07.text: Think this one through. Listen to the question, then answer out loud. Your own words are fine.

EN-SPK-T13-Q08.text: Listen to the question. Think about what really helps you, then say your answer out loud.

EN-SPK-T13-Q09.text: Get ready for a silly question. Listen, then give me your answer out loud. Any idea is welcome.

EN-SPK-T13-Q10.text: Here comes a fun question to imagine. Listen, then say your answer out loud. Let your imagination run.

EN-SPK-T14-Q01.text: Look at the three pictures. Tell the story in order: what happens first, what happens next, and what happens last.

EN-SPK-T14-Q02.text: These pictures show steps in order. Use them to tell the story out loud, from the first step to the last.

EN-SPK-T14-Q03.text: Follow the pictures from start to finish and tell the story out loud. Words like first, next and last can help.

EN-SPK-T14-Q04.text: A little story is told in these pictures. Tell it out loud, in the right order.

EN-SPK-T14-Q05.text: Go through the pictures one at a time. Tell me what happens, in order, from beginning to end.

EN-SPK-T14-Q06.text: Imagine you're explaining what happened to someone who wasn't there. Use the pictures to tell the story in order.

EN-SPK-T14-Q07.text: These pictures tell a short story. Say what happened first, then next, then at the end.

EN-SPK-T14-Q08.text: Ooh, these pictures tell a tasty story. Can you tell it out loud, in order, from start to finish?

EN-SPK-T14-Q09.text: Something changes from the first picture to the last. Tell the story out loud, step by step.

EN-SPK-T14-Q10.text: Time for a mystery. Tell the story in the pictures out loud, in order, from the first clue to the last.

EN-SPK-T15-Q01.text: Do you like helping other people? Tell me what you think, and why. There's no wrong answer here.

EN-SPK-T15-Q02.text: What's your favourite way to stay safe when you're outside? Tell me about it, and why you choose it.

EN-SPK-T15-Q03.text: Let's hear your view. Do you think saving money is a good idea? Explain why you think so.

EN-SPK-T15-Q04.text: Is it always easy to tell the truth? This is a big question. Share what you think, and why or why not.

EN-SPK-T15-Q05.text: Think about people who get left out. Why do you think it matters to include them? Tell me your thoughts.

EN-SPK-T15-Q06.text: When you feel really cross, what do you do? And does it work for you? Talk me through it.

EN-SPK-T15-Q07.text: Would you rather have one big treat now, or a bigger one later? Tell me which you'd choose, and why.

EN-SPK-T15-Q08.text: Imagine you could give an animal any superpower. What would it be, and why? Tell me all about it.

EN-SPK-T15-Q09.text: What's the funniest thing you can imagine happening at breakfast? Tell me about it, and why it's so funny.

EN-SPK-T15-Q10.text: Imagine you're in charge of the world for one day. What silly rule would you make, and why?
